policy.rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to the stated power-of-ten quantum. Approximate 700 uses one significant figure; ranges round each endpoint independently.
policy.bounds: A literal upper bound (이내) must also contain the unrounded source value; agreement after rounding alone is insufficient.
policy.coverage: Every quantity token in README prose (including both range endpoints), plus every numeric table 13 token, must have a claim. Code examples, link/image destinations, software/product/file-format identifiers (3D, 4중극, HS1, DX12, RK45, versions), list ordinals, and chapter/figure cross-references are not measured quantities. Additional bare counts and version requirements are explicitly registered below.
policy.evidence: Stored measurements only: this checker does not rerun SIMION, performance tests, visual QA, or installer builds. Source aliases below are shared selectors, not copied numeric expectations.
